section.name: Usign STable
section.p:
In the model:
Create a value object for the type of item to be displayed in the STable.
Create an ArrayList to hold the ItemModel objects to be displayed in the STable.
Populate the ArrayList with ItemModel objects.
Create a public final static selector constant that maps to the ArrayList of ItemModel objects, so when it changes the view can be updated:
public final static Selector ROSTER = Selector.fromString("rosterEntries");
Create getter and setter methods for the ArrayList.
If your model extends BasicModel, then in the setter method of the ArrayList, fire a ModelChangeEvent to automatically refresh the view when the model data changes:
this.fireModelChange(ModelChangeEvent.VALUE_CHANGED, this.ROSTER);
